usage: This phrase is used to ask if someone has any allergies, typically before medical treatment or consuming new foods.
It can function as a stand-alone question or be part of a longer sentence.
The phrase literally means 'have or not sensitive' indicating the presence or absence of allergies or sensitivities.
This is often asked by doctors or pharmacists to ensure safety with medication or dietary choices.
